title: Voice guide and style profile: single source, measurement-trait wording
description: src/site-content/README.md Voice says the house voice lives in the parent AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md says it lives in README.md. Make README the source and say so in both. Add one line distinguishing 'honest' as an author's stance ('the honest reading') from 'honest' as a measurement trait, since Limatus flags only the second. In the Papyrus style profile (branch anthus-voice-plain-statements) extend the measurement-trait pattern to 'the model knows / admits / tells the truth' phrasing found in jev-vs-laya.
